name: Dangan/Ronpa: Danse Macabre
source:
Denji Otori, the ultimate guitarist, is one of the sixteen ultimates invited by a mysterious corporation called "Ouroboros Inc." to an event called the "Ultimate unification program". It was supposed to be a nice vacation in a prestigious hotel, but something went very, very wrong. Denji woke up on a mysterious tropical island with the other ultimates. Who will survive and who will die in the waltz they dance with death? Stay tuned to find out!

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/DRDM/758550]GameJolt[/url]]
